cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've completed the budget report. Just the title page: I'm leaving the board room to contribute.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They meet in ten minutes and need your figures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's the finished discussion edition. You know the chair best; would a one-line recommendation keep things moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She wants a recommendation backed by numbers. Put your projected saving at the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll put 'Save money' at the top, in whatever size she prefers. A finished headline edition; the figures won't distract from the recommendation.
